title: NEMO for Cryo-EM Facility Data Pipeline Management and Automation
content: The National Cryo-EM Facility (NCEF) at Frederick National Laboratory for Cancer Research (FNLCR) conducts a free point of service, high-resolution cryo-EM imaging for the academic, non-profit, cancer research community within the United States. Managing a cryo-EM facility involves tracking and integrating multiple types of data from many sources. Sample inventories, user profiles, project descriptions, grid preparation, grid inventory, screening images, data images, and image metadata are just some of a non-exclusive list of data that needs to be tracked, distributed, and summarized into reports. Due to the expensive nature of many Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), laboratories will often get by on an array of spread sheets and other associated files.
